question: For the 'September Meeting' event, calculate (1) the percentage of the total budget allocated to 'Advertisement', and (2) the total amount spent on all approved expenses for this event. Additionally, count how many attendees of this event wear medium-sized T-shirts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement' THEN b.XCL_007 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(b.XCL_007)
   FROM budget AS b
   JOIN event AS e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010
   WHERE e.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting')
  || ' ' ||
  (SELECT SUM(x.XCL_020)
   FROM expense AS x
   JOIN budget AS b2 ON x.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
   JOIN event AS e2 ON b2.XCL_009 = e2.XCL_010
   WHERE e2.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting' AND x.XCL_021 = 'true')
  || ' ' ||
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM attendance AS a
   JOIN event AS e3 ON a.XCL_001 = e3.XCL_010
   JOIN member AS m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_034
   WHERE e3.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting' AND m.XCL_039 = 'Medium')

  (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement' THEN b.XCL_007 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(b.XCL_007)
   FROM budget AS b
   JOIN event AS e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010
   WHERE e.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting')
  || ' ' ||
  (SELECT SUM(x.XCL_020)
   FROM expense AS x
   JOIN budget AS b2 ON x.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
   JOIN event AS e2 ON b2.XCL_009 = e2.XCL_010
   WHERE e2.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting' AND x.XCL_021 = 'true')
  || ' ' ||
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM attendance AS a
   JOIN event AS e3 ON a.XCL_001 = e3.XCL_010
   JOIN member AS m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_034
   WHERE e3.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting' AND m.XCL_039 = 'Medium')

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement' THEN b.XCL_007 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(b.XCL_007)
     FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010
     WHERE e.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting')
    || ' ' ||
    (SELECT SUM(x.XCL_020)
     FROM expense x JOIN budget b2 ON x.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
     JOIN event e2 ON b2.XCL_009 = e2.XCL_010
     WHERE e2.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting' AND x.XCL_021 = 'true')
    || ' ' ||
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM attendance a JOIN event e3 ON a.XCL_001 = e3.XCL_010
     JOIN member m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_034
     WHERE e3.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting' AND m.XCL_039 = 'Medium')

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_008 = 'Advertisement' THEN b.XCL_006 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(b.XCL_006)) AS percentage_advertisement,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_021 = 'Approved' THEN e.XCL_020 ELSE 0 END) AS total_approved_expenses,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.XCL_039 = 'Medium' THEN 1 END) AS count_medium_tshirts
FROM event ev
JOIN budget b ON ev.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
LEFT JOIN expense e ON ev.XCL_010 = e.XCL_018
LEFT JOIN attendance a ON ev.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001
LEFT JOIN member m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_034
WHERE ev.XCL_011 = 'September Meeting'
